Starlink Mobile will be available in Italy with @FASTWEB.  The service will keep customers connected via apps and text messaging in remote areas without signal 🛰️📱


FASTWEB (@FASTWEB)

Montagne, aree remote, zone costiere isolate: Fastweb e @Starlink avviano una sperimentazione in una zona limitata del Paese per portare la connessione dove prima non arrivava, aprendo la strada ad una copertura mobile unica nel suo genere in Italia.

Dove non c’è copertura di rete terrestre, entrano in gioco i satelliti in orbita bassa di Starlink Mobile, il primo progetto Direct to Cell in Italia.

Non c’è campo? Lo smartphone si connetterà automaticamente alla rete via satellite per continuare a usare WhatsApp, Google Maps, SMS e le principali app abilitate a questa tecnologia senza fare nulla.

È anche così che costruiamo ogni giorno una connettività davvero senza limiti.

Buying a Tesla is easy

Order within 2 mins on our website, then complete the entire process in the Tesla app


Katie Miller (@KatieMiller)

“My @Tesla buying experience was nothing like anything I’ve ever experienced before. Normally, when you buy a car, you go to a dealership, test drive the vehicle, haggle with the salesperson, and then deal with the finance team—which is usually way worse than the sales staff. I still remember one car I bought years ago that took a full six hours. It was miserable.

“This time, I wasn’t even sure I was going to buy a Tesla. I just wanted to test drive one—I’d never even ridden in one before. I hadn’t looked at the Model Y much, though I saw them on the road all the time. Like a lot of gas-car drivers, I used to think EVs were kind of stupid. But over the years, Tesla’s infrastructure has improved so much that I decided it was worth checking out.

“My current car was a 2020 Volvo that was starting to show its age. Even though I had promised my husband I’d keep it forever, maintenance was getting ridiculous. The 50,000-mile service alone cost around $800. So I booked a test drive appointment for 1:00 p.m.

“At the center, a Tesla advisor drove me first to show me how Autopilot worked, then handed me the keys. I only drove for about 10 minutes, came back, and spent some time exploring all the car’s features. After that, I was sold. I wanted it.

“Before going in, I had already checked Tesla’s trade-in offer on my Volvo and it was significantly better than what Carvana was quoting. The numbers made sense. All I had to do was fill out the finance application. The rate was an incredible 0.99%, and if I kept the loan the entire term, the total finance charges would only be about $800. That was a no-brainer.

“I arrived at 1:00 p.m. and drove home in my new Tesla around 5:00 p.m. Most of that time wasn’t even at the Tesla center—I had to run home to eat, find my title, clean out my old car, talk to my husband, and head back. If I had done all that in advance and had the car cleared out with the title in hand, I probably would have been in and out in about an hour.

“They also happened to have the exact model, color, and configuration I would have ordered on the spot. I didn’t have to wait for a custom build.

“Super long rant, but that’s my Tesla car buying story!”

Grok Build is now fully open source, and SpaceXAI has made its privacy-first approach even stronger

SpaceXAI has officially:
• Open-sourced the Grok Build harness CLI
• Reset usage limits for all users
• Disabled data retention by default
• Deleted all previously retained coding data
• Made the harness fully local-first, allowing you to run it with your own inference

Since launch, Grok Build has supported Zero Data Retention (ZDR) for users who opted in

Now, based on community feedback, SpaceXAI has gone a step further: Data retention is now OFF by default for everyone

Your coding sessions remain private by default, with retention entirely under your control

By combining an open-source harness, local-first execution, zero retention by default, and the deletion of previously retained coding data, SpaceXAI is setting a new standard for privacy in AI coding tools

Transparent, open, and built to give users complete control over their data


SpaceXAI (@SpaceXAI)
